title: forge build: lower to executable Rust + rustc -> a compiled, L1-contract-checked artifact (no new compiler)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Implement forge build: reuse check_file's pipeline front (parse/validate/check_effects), then thermite_lower::lower_l1 -> write a self-contained crate into a per-run check::ScratchDir (reuse #53 Drop guard) -> invoke real rustc (exit-checked, --crate-name gotcha, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 + --remap-path-prefix for byte-reproducibility). Default rlib; --entry appends a deterministic generated main synthesizing fixed sample inputs per param type. BuildManifest (separate struct composing effects_of, not the frozen Certificate schema) records artifact path/crate-type, honest L1 assurance, per-fn fx rows (the #57 hook), reproducibility. New ForgeError::{RustcAbsent,RustcSpawn,RustcOutput}. Verified by forge/tests/build_conformance.rs (6 tests, AC-1..AC-7) against conformance/build/cases.json.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED — forge build: a Thermite program is now a runnable, contract-checked native binary (NO new compiler — transpile to Rust + rustc). build.rs build_file: parse -> validate -> check_effects -> lower_l1 (always-active thermite_check!) -> emit a Rust crate in a ScratchDir (#53 wholesale cleanup) -> rustc (exit-checked, --crate-name gotcha, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH+remap-path-prefix -> byte-identical artifacts) -> a compiled artifact + BuildManifest (artifact path, honest assurance 'L1 (built, runtime-checked)', per-fn fx rows = the #57 seccomp input). Library baseline; --entry <fn> appends a deterministic synthesized-input main -> runnable executable. Loop: doc-author -> builder -> critic NO DIVERGENCE: real rustc-compiled artifact runs (sum(&[1,2,3])=6); the runtime L1 check GENUINELY FIRES (bad ens-violation -> exit 101 + 'thermite L1 contract violation [ens]', confirmed even under -O release — it's , not debug_assert); rustc-failure -> ForgeError (R-CODE-4); no leaked artifacts; --entry no-panic; reproducible; honest assurance. Commit aab1a72. workspace 394 tests, clippy/fmt clean. The runnable-binary gate for #57 (the seccomp sandbox). Note (design-conformant): a loop inv is runtime-checked at each iteration head, not post-final-body (ens-at-exit is the runtime guarantee; L3 is the inductive one — per l1-runtime-checks.md). Not pushed.
